benchmark_metadata.suggestion_policy: Capture the initial suggestions, apply each distinct suggestion once at its original text offset, and do not recheck after edits.

B-01.text: Bro that clutch was so cracked for fur, but my keyboard glitchd during the defuse. We gotta climb back up the ranks tonite cuz tomorrow is patch day.

B-02.text: Old man Miller was sitting by the woodstove whittling an ax handle, listening to the howling wind. He figured winter was gonna hit early this year.

B-03.text: Rain drummed against the cracked plasglas. He popped the neural deck open, swapped the fried heatsink, and waited for the optics to recalabrate.

B-04.text: The Ethiopian yirgacheffe had an intensely floral aroma with notes of bergamot, but the roast profile was slightly too dark, masking the delicate stonefruit acidity.

B-05.text: The little puppy ran across the grass chasing a yellow ball. He jumped in the muddy puddle and started splashing everywhere until his paws were dark brown.

B-06.text: The saync worker crashed due to an unhandled null pointer in the redis cache layer. We rolled back the commit and increased the connection pool timeout.

B-07.text: We trapped their point guard in the backcourt and forced a turnover. Marcus caught an alley-oop pass in transition and threw down a Thunderous dunk!

B-08.text: Frost crept silently across the cold windowpane. The room grew still, shadowed by the fading dusk, as if the whole world was holding its breath for the snow.

B-09.text: Examined a juvenile barn owl with a fractured left humerus. The wing feathers were clean and the raptor showed strong aggressive defense reflexes.

B-10.text: Pursuant to Section 8, the supplier shall reimburse the buyer for any unauthorized shipment expenses incurred prior to the termination date.
